description: This PHP source file defines a service class 'LeavePeriodService' within the 'OrangeHRM' HR management system. It manages leave period calculations, retrieval of leave period history, generating leave periods over date ranges, and provides methods to access current leave periods and related data. The class relies on various traits and external DAO and DTO classes for data handling and operations related to leave periods.
